take.title_zh: AI 設計工具大戰：Figma、Google、Anthropic 三方重塑設計師工作方式
take.title_en: The AI Design Tool Wars: Figma, Google, and Anthropic Rewrite the Rules
take.body_zh:
本週設計圈最大震撼是三股力量的同步出擊：Figma 在畫布內嵌入原生 AI 助理並串聯 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的 agent；Google 在 I/O 大會宣告「AI 設計是下一個主戰場」並推出 Pics 應用；而 Anthropic 更早一步以 Claude Design 直接攻打 Figma、Canva 的地盤。這不再只是功能迭代，而是整個工具層的重組。

對設計師而言，這波浪潮帶來的不只是效率提升，更是角色的根本轉變——從「像素推手」到「AI 指揮官」。懂得設定 AI agent 邊界、審視輸出品質、維護品牌一致性的設計師，將在這場重組中站穩位置；而僅依賴熟悉工具操作的人，恐面臨被快速取代的壓力。現在正是深化系統思維與判斷力的時刻。
take.body_en:
This week saw a three-way AI design offensive: Figma embedded a native AI assistant into its canvas with OpenAI and Anthropic integrations; Google declared AI design the next big battleground at I/O and launched the Pics app; Anthropic's Claude Design had already staked a claim in territory once owned by Figma and Canva. This is not just feature iteration—it is a structural reshaping of the entire design tools layer.

For designers, the implications run deeper than productivity gains. The shift is fundamentally about role transformation—from pixel-pusher to AI director. Those who can define agent boundaries, evaluate output quality, and maintain brand coherence will thrive; those relying purely on tool familiarity face real displacement risk. This is the moment to double down on systems thinking and editorial judgment.

articles.title_zh: Figma 在協作畫布嵌入原生 AI 設計助理
articles.title_en: Figma Adds a Native AI Assistant to Its Collaborative Canvas
articles.summary_zh: Figma 正式推出原生 AI 設計助理，直接整合於協作畫布（Canvas）中。設計師可透過自然語言提示創建新設計、修改現有元素，甚至同時啟動多個 AI agent 並行處理不同任務。搭配與 OpenAI（Codex）及 Anthropic（Claude Code）的深度整合，AI 協作從「輔助工具」升格為設計流程的核心引擎。此次更新也呼應 Figma Q1 2026 營收突破 3.33 億美元、年增 46% 的強勁成長動能。
articles.summary_en: Figma launched a native AI assistant embedded directly in its collaborative canvas. Designers can use natural language to create designs, modify elements, or automate tasks—running multiple AI agents in parallel. Deep integrations with OpenAI Codex and Anthropic Claude Code position the tool as a core design engine, not a helper. The launch aligns with Figma Q1 2026 revenue of 33.4M, up 46% year-over-year.
articles.take_zh: Figma 不再只是「設計工具」，而是正在成為設計師的 AI 指揮中心。多 agent 並行能力預示著設計工作流將大幅自動化，設計師的核心價值將轉向判斷力與系統思維。
articles.take_en: Figma is evolving from design tool to AI command center. Multi-agent parallel execution signals a future of largely automated workflows—shifting designer value toward judgment, curation, and systems thinking.

articles.title_zh: Google I/O 宣告 AI 設計工具是下一個主戰場
articles.title_en: Google Declares AI Design the Next Big Battleground at I/O 2026
articles.summary_zh: Google 在 I/O 2026 上宣示全力進軍 AI 設計工具市場，並推出整合至 Google Workspace 的新應用 Pics——讓用戶以文字提示生成社群素材、邀請函、行銷視覺等，無需設計技能。Pics 將先向測試群開放，今夏推廣至 Google AI Ultra 訂閱用戶。此舉與 Figma 原生 AI 助理、Anthropic Claude Design 的推出同步，標誌著 AI 設計工具競賽進入白熱化階段。
articles.summary_en: At Google I/O 2026, Google unveiled Pics—an AI-powered design app for Google Workspace that generates social graphics, invitations, and marketing materials from text prompts, no design skills needed. Launching to testers at I/O and rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers this summer, Pics enters a crowded field alongside Figma AI and Anthropic Claude Design.
articles.take_zh: Google 的入場讓 AI 設計工具形成三足鼎立：Figma 守住專業設計師陣地，Anthropic 搶攻非設計師市場，Google 從 Workspace 生態系切入。這場競爭的勝負，很大程度取決於誰能掌握「非設計師用戶」的使用習慣。
articles.take_en: Google's entry creates a three-way AI design standoff: Figma holds the pro base, Anthropic targets non-designers, and Google enters via Workspace ubiquity. The winner may be whoever best captures the non-designer majority.

articles.title_zh: Figma 攜手 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 推出 AI Agent 整合設計工作流
articles.title_en: Figma Partners With OpenAI and Anthropic to Bring AI Agents Into Design Workflows
articles.summary_zh: Figma 正式宣佈與 OpenAI 及 Anthropic 建立 AI agent 合作，將 OpenAI Codex 與 Anthropic Claude Code 整合進設計工作流。設計師可在畫布直接調用這些 agent 自動完成設計任務、協作編輯或重複性操作，且支援多個 agent 同時執行。這是 Figma 從「設計工具」轉型為「AI 設計作業系統」的關鍵一步，也在 IPO 前強化了其護城河建設。
articles.summary_en: Figma announced formal AI agent partnerships with OpenAI and Anthropic, integrating Codex and Claude Code natively into its platform. Designers can invoke agents directly on canvas to automate tasks, collaborate, or handle repetitive work—with multiple agents running simultaneously. This is Figma's pivotal step from design tool to AI-native design operating system, ahead of its anticipated IPO.
articles.take_zh: Figma 選擇「整合」而非「自建」大模型，是聰明的平台策略——讓 AI 能力由最強的外部 agent 提供，自己專注於設計體驗與協作層。這種開放式 agent 架構，很可能成為下一代設計工具的標準模式。
articles.take_en: Figma's choice to integrate rather than build its own LLMs is a smart platform play—outsource AI capability to best-in-class agents, own the design experience layer. This open-agent architecture may define the next-gen design tool standard.

articles.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Design，挑戰 Figma 與 Canva
articles.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Design, an AI Tool That Turns Prompts Into Prototypes
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出獨立產品 Claude Design，讓用戶透過對話提示生成完整的視覺作品——設計稿、互動原型、投影片、一頁式行銷文件與廣告素材。此產品以 research preview 形式開放給所有付費 Claude 訂閱用戶，定位為面向創辦人、PM 和行銷人員等「從未打開過 Figma 的人」。這是 Anthropic 最積極向應用層擴張的一步，直接衝擊 Figma、Adobe 和 Canva 的地盤。
articles.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Design, a standalone product that generates complete visual work—designs, interactive prototypes, slide decks, one-pagers, and marketing collateral—from conversational prompts. Available in research preview to all paid Claude subscribers, it targets founders, PMs, and marketers who have never opened Figma. This is Anthropic's most aggressive expansion into the application layer, directly competing with Figma, Adobe, and Canva.
articles.take_zh: Claude Design 最有趣的切入點是「非設計師」市場——它不是要取代設計師，而是讓 PM 和創辦人跳過設計師直接出稿。這對設計工具市場的長期影響，值得設計師認真觀察。
articles.take_en: Claude Design's most interesting angle is the non-designer market—it is not replacing designers, but enabling PMs and founders to ship assets without them. The long-term structural impact on design workflows is worth watching closely.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 推出三款即時語音 AI 模型，強化對話 Agent 能力
articles.title_en: OpenAI Launches Three Real-Time Audio Models for Conversational AI Agents
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出三款全新即時語音模型：GPT-Realtime-2（對話任務執行）、GPT-Realtime-Translate（跨 70+ 語言即時翻譯）、GPT-Realtime-Whisper（即時轉錄與字幕生成）。三款模型主要面向語音 AI agent 開發者，大幅降低多語言對話應用的建構門檻。對於思考語音介面的 UX 設計師而言，這批基礎設施工具的成熟代表語音 UX 的設計需求即將爆發。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI released three real-time audio models: GPT-Realtime-2 for conversational task execution, GPT-Realtime-Translate for multilingual translation across 70+ languages, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper for live transcription and captioning. Targeting voice AI agent developers, these models lower the barrier for multilingual conversational apps—and signal an incoming wave of voice UX design demand.
articles.take_zh: 語音介面不再只是「無障礙功能」，而是正在成為主流互動模式。UX 設計師必須開始認真思考語音流程設計、錯誤處理與多語系一致性問題。
articles.take_en: Voice interfaces are graduating from accessibility feature to mainstream interaction mode. UX designers need to start seriously designing for voice flows, error handling, and multilingual consistency.

articles.title_zh: Google 搶在 Apple AI 反攻前，將 Gemini 推至 Android 核心
articles.title_en: Google Races to Put Gemini at the Core of Android Before Apple's AI Reboot
articles.summary_zh: Google 正加速將 Gemini AI 深度整合至 Android 系統核心，包括系統級操作、Google Assistant 替換及搜尋功能重構。這場競速的背景是 Apple 即將推出全面升級的 AI 版 iOS，兩大行動平台即將進入 AI 原生系統大戰。對 Android app 設計師而言，Gemini 的系統級整合意味著需要重新思考 app 與作業系統 AI 的互動邊界與職責劃分。
articles.summary_en: Google is aggressively embedding Gemini into Android's core—replacing Google Assistant, integrating system-level AI, and overhauling search. The race is driven by Apple's upcoming AI-native iOS reboot. For Android app designers, Gemini's system-level integration means rethinking the interaction boundary between apps and OS-level AI.
articles.take_zh: 行動平台正從「App Store 生態」轉向「AI 原生作業系統」競爭。設計師必須開始思考：當 OS 本身就是最強的 AI 介面，App 的差異化還剩下什麼？
articles.take_en: Mobile platforms are shifting from App Store ecosystems to AI-native OS competition. When the OS becomes the most powerful AI interface, what is left to differentiate at the app layer?
